brief: Twin-arch stone culvert-bridge on a narrow country road: two semicircular arches of rough-dressed buff limestone voussoirs in coursed rubble walls with a central pier and square end piers, a low solid stone parapet with a heavy coping, and later steel guardrail attached behind. Heavily wooded ravine, dark stream with fallen timber. Only two distinct photos are available on Commons.

traits.railing_detail: low solid stone parapet with coping, guardrail behind
